en.quote: 2018 will see the first crewed launch [from Vostochny].
en.head: The target moved to 2025 or later
en.body: In August 2015, Izvestia reported that the first crewed launch from Vostochny had been postponed to no earlier than 2025; Roscosmos replied that the decree setting 2018 had not been revoked. The first uncrewed launch, scheduled for December 2015, took place on April 28, 2016.
